newsitem.title: HONG KONG: One-third of condoms found unsafe in Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: One-third of condoms found unsafe in Hong Kong.

text.p: More than one third of condoms on sale in Hong Kong are unsafe, Hong Kong government radio said on Monday, quoting the territory's consumer affairs watchdog.
The Consumer Council tested 95 kinds, and as a result the Customs and Excise Department recently seized 400,000 faulty condoms from 11 distributors and seven retailers, it said.
Customs officers were now considering legal action.
The Consumer Council said that despite the seizures, unsafe condoms might still be on sale in some Hong Kong shops.
